home.intro: Four hours of footage. One story. Ninety seconds of work.
home.body: SudoCut finds the silence, the filler, the retakes and the tangents in your footage. It proposes the cuts. You make the call.

numbers.note: One real project, start to finish. Not an average.

one.label: Raw to final cut, in a single pass.

two.label: Trimmed. Nothing you wanted is gone.

three.label: Cuts flagged for review. The rest passes straight through.

principles.title: How we work
principles.two: We shipped a hand-edited cut and an AI-edited cut side by side. Viewers couldn't tell.
principles.three: If it doesn't work, we write that down. A demo that looks better than the product is a lie.

about.title: SudoCut builds one thing.
about.lede: An editor that removes what nobody watches. That's the whole company.

body.one: It does the pass an editor does by hand: strip the silence, cut the stumbles, drop the tangents. What's left is the part that needs a human.
body.two: Korean is the default. English runs in parallel. Neither is a translation of the other — both are written in their own language.
body.three: Every cut carries its reason on screen: silence, filler, retake, tangent, needs review. Nothing disappears without one.

principles.title: What we hold to
principles.two: Numbers instead of adjectives. 6:12, not "significant time savings."
principles.three: Editor to editor. We don't explain what you already know.
principles.four: Honesty over polish. The failures get written down too.

contact.title: Just the ask.
contact.body: Product questions, partnerships, hiring, press — they all land at one address. We read every one.
